changes_vs_current: Lab and Golden now 1-2 (Golden was 1). French Bulldog falls out (was 5; AKC #1 but YouGov ranks it 80th and it is absent from Forbes top 10), plus Husky, Great Dane, Chihuahua, Goldendoodle, Pit Bull, Shiba, Pug, Dalmatian, Siberian Husky dropped. Added English Bulldog already existed; newly added: German Shorthaired Pointer, Shetland Sheepdog, Miniature American Shepherd, Cane Corso, Yorkshire Terrier, Alaskan Malamute, Entlebucher, Boston Terrier, Shih Tzu. Ranks 8-24 are separated by under 3 points (near-ties).
confidence: medium-low. 4 real sources but they measure different things (registrations vs cuteness head-to-head vs owner favorites) and disagree sharply on French Bulldog, Goldendoodle and Husky. YouGov full 193-breed table is not published on the page, so its missing-rank penalty is an assumption. Entlebucher and Malamute are YouGov head-to-head artifacts and may be too obscure for a typing game; Frenchie arguably should be kept (AKC #1 four years running, Rover #6). Ranker not fetchable.
